why.heading: Why Credtech Solutions?
paras: We believe that real marketing success means pairing reliable, trustworthy communication with modern marketing technology. Our name says it: we earn credibility for brands while using the latest digital tools to deliver meaningful marketing and PR results.
We are a collective of forward-thinking minds in social media, public relations and media strategy, and we have been setting new standards in communication and digital marketing since we started.
We have a presence across India, with end-to-end support for clients in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Jaipur, and we are expanding to the rest of the country.

seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: How Credtech Solutions collects, uses and shares personal information.

privacy.title: Our commitment to your privacy
intro: We believe effective marketing and public relations are built on trust and transparency, and that extends to how we handle your personal information. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it to deliver our services, and your rights regarding your information.
Your privacy matters to us, and we safeguard your data with the same diligence we apply to every campaign we create.

sections.heading: 1. The information we collect
paras: Our goal is to deliver exceptional marketing and PR services, and to do that we collect specific types of information, always with respect for your privacy.

Information you provide, such as your name, contact details, company information and job title when you enquire about our services, subscribe to our newsletter or become a client. We use it to respond to your needs, manage client relationships and fulfil our service agreements.

Information collected automatically through your website interactions. This covers non-personally identifiable data such as your IP address, browser type and pages visited, often through cookies and tracking technologies. It helps us understand website usage, improve functionality and optimise our digital presence.

Information from third-party sources, including publicly available professional contact details from industry databases and social media, used for legitimate purposes such as media outreach, influencer identification and market research, always within ethical and legal boundaries. We collect only what is necessary.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your information
paras: Service delivery and client management. Running marketing campaigns (digital, content, social media and SEO), managing public relations work (including press releases and media relations), onboarding clients, overseeing projects and providing client support.
Personalising your experience. Tailoring our communications, proposals and content to your business needs and interests.
Website and service optimisation. Analysing user interactions to improve functionality and develop new features.
Communication and outreach. Sending insights and updates, with an easy opt-out, and responding to your enquiries.
Security and compliance. Protecting our systems, preventing fraud and meeting legal obligations.

sections.heading: 3. How we share your information
paras: We share your information only when necessary, always with security and purpose in mind.

Trusted service providers. Partners such as CRM systems, cloud hosts and email marketing platforms that help us run our business and deliver our services. They are carefully vetted and legally bound to protect your data and use it only for the purposes we define.
Business transfers. In a merger or acquisition, your information may be among the assets transferred, always under strict confidentiality agreements.

Legal compliance and protection. We may disclose information when required by law, such as a court order or government regulation, or when necessary to protect our rights, property or the safety of our users or the public.
For any sharing beyond these purposes, we will always ask for your explicit consent.

privacy.contactLine: Questions about this policy? Email info@credtechsolutions.com.
privacy.reviewNote: The live policy stops after section 3 in mid-sentence and has no sections on data retention, user rights, cookies consent or grievance contact. Have it reviewed against India's DPDP Act before launch.
